title: For each financial aid year and academic year where the term status is 'Pre
question: For each financial aid year and academic year where the term status is 'Previous', show the financial aid year, academic year, academic year description, department name, the total number of terms in that academic year, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all library reserve materials offered in terms with a material status of 'U' for that academic year and department. For each financial aid year, include a grand total for all terms in the format of (financial aid year, null, null, null, total terms, null). For each academic year, also include a grand total across all departments in the format of (financial aid year, academic year, academic year description, null, total terms, total coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)). Do not return any rounded answers.

rr.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.total_terms, dv.coefficient_of_variation FROM RollupResults AS rr LEFT JOIN DeptVariation AS dv ON WITH terms AS (
  SELECT TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR
  FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS
  WHERE TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'
),
mat AS (
  SELECT t.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
         i.DEPARTMENT,
         SUM(d.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d
  JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR i ON d.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = i.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  JOIN terms t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
  WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'
  GROUP BY t.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT
),
dept AS (
  SELECT m.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, m.DEPARTMENT,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM terms t2 WHERE t2.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR = m.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR AND t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = m.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS total_terms,
         STDDEV(m.total_units) / AVG(m.total_units) AS cv
  FROM mat m
),
ay AS (
  SELECT m.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM terms t2 WHERE t2.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR = m.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR AND t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = m.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS total_terms,
         STDDEV(m.total_units) / AVG(m.total_units) AS cv
  FROM mat m
  GROUP BY m.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
),
fy AS (
  SELECT m.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM terms t2 WHERE t2.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR = m.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR) AS total_terms
  FROM mat m
  GROUP BY m.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR
)
SELECT d.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT, d.total_terms, d.cv
FROM dept d
UNION ALL
SELECT a.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL, a.total_terms, a.cv
FROM ay a
UNION ALL
SELECT f.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, NULL, NULL, NULL, f.total_terms, NULL
FROM fy f
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4;
